style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
subject: ONE colugo, flying lemur, big round eyes, mottled grey fur, wide skin membrane between all four limbs; same animal
second_characters: stick insects in neckties, tax clerks, huge at the lens

props.coins: blank coins, no markings, under the membrane
props.strip: a blank paper strip, unrolled at the lens

environment: jungle trunk at noon, a dense wall of leaves and vines behind him, bark chips and pollen flying
lighting: flat white daylight through the canopy, cyan rim left, warm amber kick right, no shade
motion_rule: the hero climbs and swings round the trunk on his own claws and never stops: he throws his body the full frame width ALWAYS SIDEWAYS, filling half the frame height, muzzle to the lens. The world flies INTO the lens: leaves, bark chips and clerks rush at the glass every beat. New shot size every beat, medium to close. ONE move per beat, not a chain.

audio.rate: 3.3 syllables per second, each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, speech ends by 6.65, then leaves and claws
audio.lip_sync: jaw opens on every syllable, mouth empty while speaking, coins held under the membrane
audio.pronunciation: tvo-I, DEN-gi, na-LOG, u-CHYOL, nay-DYOT, DZHUN-glyakh

timeline.a: drops off the branch and swings the full frame width round the trunk upside down at the lens, coins bursting from under his membrane
catches the bark on the far side and hauls himself back across the frame; a clerk snatches a coin at the glass
rakes the coins back under the membrane on the move and swings the full width the other way; two clerks tumble over the lens
hauls himself up the bark hand over hand, membrane flapping edge to edge; a clerk unrolls a blank paper strip across the lens
whips the full frame width across the bark the other way, muzzle to the lens; clerks sweep sideways over the glass after him
throws himself the full width back, bark chips bursting; a clerk drags the paper strip right across the lens after him
hurls his body the full frame width, coins trapped under the snapping membrane; three clerks shoot across the lens
drives up the trunk through the leaves, membrane tight to his belly, muzzle to the lens; clerks stream past on both sides
swings across the frame and flings the membrane open at the lens: three clerks inside it counting his coins
the clerks hand him the last coin, he grabs at it and they tip him off the trunk, legs clawing, muzzle to the lens
swings the full frame width back across the bark; clerks sweep over his membrane into the lens
a clerk hangs its necktie on his ear as he claws sideways, eyes rolling into the lens, membrane whipping
he throws his head and open membrane into the lens, muzzle filling the frame, empty paws up; coins rain out behind him

must_appear: at 0.00 mid swing across the frame, coins bursting from under the membrane; the paper strip unrolled at 1.90; the membrane flung open at 6.65 with clerks counting inside it; the necktie on his ear; his muzzle into the lens at 9.40
negative_prompt: printed words, digits, Cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, black bars, night, dark scene, a glide between trees, hero riding a belt or cart, a prop worked in place, a hero running on his feet, parked camera, push in, motionless or empty background, wide shot, view from behind, lowered head during speech, a motionless first or last second, speech after 6.65, English speech, a second colugo
